Each identity must solve a fresh challenge derived from live system entropy plus a signed juniper-marked seed, and the solution must embed a unique nonce that the verifier checks against prior submissions. Replays and copies fail because the challenge never recurs. An attacker pays one full compute cycle per identity plus a growing replay-check lookup, and each solved ember expires unused within minutes, forcing continuous fresh spend.
